vision.visionTitle1: The Payment Rails of the AI Economy
vision.visionTitle2: The Global Standard for Value Exchange
vision.visionDesc: In a world where AI agents transact autonomously, even a fraction of a cent worth of data must reach anywhere on the globe in 0.1 seconds. WiseLake builds that pathway.
vision.missionDesc: An ecosystem where every piece of content and every data point is paid its fair value. NanoTrans, built on the x402 Protocol, is already taking that first step.

problem.label: Problem
problem.subtitle2: Legacy payment systems cannot keep up.

minAmount.title: Minimum Transaction Too High
minAmount.desc: A $0.01 data query, a $0.001 news sentence — in legacy payment systems, fees exceed the principal. Nano-scale transactions between AI agents simply cannot happen.

latency.title: Slow Settlement
latency.desc: AI agents decide their next action in 0.01 seconds. Settlement that takes 1 second to several days is incompatible with the speed of the AI economy.

model.title: Heavy Billing Models
model.desc: Subscriptions charge for what you don't use. Ads sell user attention. Neither concept exists for AI agents.

problem.conclusion_line1: The AI economy has already begun.
problem.conclusion_line2: Only the payment infrastructure is still stuck in the past.

nanotrans.title: Get Paid When AI Agents Read Your Content
nanotrans.subtitle: With HTTP 402 and the x402 protocol, AI agents discover and pay for your content — settled trustlessly on-chain in USDC on Base L2.

microPayment.title: x402 Paywall
microPayment.desc: Each article responds to agent requests with HTTP 402 and on-chain payment terms. Set per-article or sitewide pricing in USDC.

settlement.title: Bazaar Discovery
settlement.desc: Structured Bazaar metadata lists your content in the Coinbase CDP catalog and agent marketplaces, so AI agents can actually find it.

payPerContent.title: WordPress-Native
payPerContent.desc: A standard plugin with a paywall metabox and a Gutenberg sidebar. Just set your wallet — no blockchain code required.

payPerUse.title: On-chain Splits · 90%+
payPerUse.desc: The immutable NanoTransSplitter contract divides every payment automatically. No custody, no manual payouts — creators keep 90%+.

coreTech.label: How it works
coreTech.title: Four Trustless Foundations
coreTech.subtitle: From discovery to payment, non-custodial security, and on-chain splits — all verifiable on the x402 standard and Base L2.
coreTech.protocol: All built on the x402 standard

nanoSense.name: x402 Protocol
nanoSense.desc: On the **HTTP 402** standard, agents **discover, verify, pay, and consume** content. Each **x402 v2** response carries the payment terms and Bazaar discovery metadata.

nanoVault.name: Non-custodial
nanoVault.desc: NanoTrans **never holds your funds.** Payments split directly on-chain, and payment credentials live only in a **Cloudflare Worker** — never in WordPress.

nanoPulse.name: USDC · Base L2
nanoPulse.desc: Settlement happens in **USDC on Base L2** — no intermediary, finalized on-chain the moment an agent pays.

nanoSplit.name: Verifiable Splitter
nanoSplit.desc: The immutable **NanoTransSplitter** divides revenue instantly. Its **deterministic address and verified code hash** are checked before settlement, and creators keep **90%+**.

pigplan.title: #1 Market Share in Korean Swine ERP
pigplan.desc: PigPlan is the market-leading swine ERP solution used by Korea's top livestock cooperatives and enterprises including Dodram, Dabi Genetics, and Woosung Feed.
pigplan.psy: PSY (Pigs per Sow per Year) is the key metric determining farm profitability. Farms that consistently log data in PigPlan show meaningfully higher PSY compared to those that don't. Over 20 years of data proves it.
pigplan.clients: Key Clients: Dodram, Dabi Genetics, Woosung Feed

partners.label: Trusted by Industry Leaders
partners.mafra: Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs
partners.kape: Korea Institute for Animal Products Quality Evaluation

insightPigplan.label: Insight PigPlan
insightPigplan.title: Weekly AI Management Report
insightPigplan.desc: Insight PigPlan uses AI to analyze your PigPlan data and condense your farm's whole week into one report every Monday — five tabs (summary, production, shipment, loss, diagnosis) with an overall GREEN/YELLOW/RED grade, readable in 10 minutes on KakaoTalk.
insightPigplan.benefit: It quantifies losses in won and warns you before problems hit, using a 13-week trend plus a 4-week forecast.

flow.title: How it works
flow.s1_desc: It uses the PigPlan data your farm already enters every day.
flow.s2_desc: It analyzes performance, loss, and cause, and assigns an overall GREEN/YELLOW/RED grade.
flow.s3_desc: Every Monday at 8 AM or 2 PM, the five-tab report is delivered via KakaoTalk and SMS.

features.f1_desc: Quantifies five loss categories and shows the expected return of each improvement in won.
features.f2_desc: Detects anomalies in advance with a 13-week trend and a 4-week forecast.
features.f3_desc: Shows where your farm ranks nationwide against similar-sized farms (top, mid, bottom).

pigplanCore.label: PigOS
pigplanCore.title: An AI Early-Warning System for Pig Farms
pigplanCore.subtitle: Log a record → AI judges → loss prevented
pigplanCore.desc_line1: PigOS is an AI-native operating system that connects farm records, KPI benchmarks, risk signals, and reports into one platform.
pigplanCore.desc_line2: With country-calibrated metrics (Korea, US, SEA, Latin America) and rule-based AI, it detects losses before month-end.
pigplanCore.f1_desc: PSY, MSY, wean count, mortality, and finishing performance on mobile in real time — works offline.
pigplanCore.f2_desc: Automatically detects loss patterns and anomalies, and surfaces this week's top-3 action priorities.
pigplanCore.f3_desc: Ask in natural language — "Why did PSY drop?" — and get data-backed answers like a farm consultant.
pigplanCore.f4_desc: Every morning, the day's top-3 actions delivered from overnight AI monitoring.
pigplanCore.status: Free to start — no credit card · pigos.io

suggest.title: Suggest

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.desc: Farm teams review, correct, or approve before any decision.

act.title: Act
act.desc: Confirmed records become loss signals and prioritized actions.

pigSignal.label: PigSignal
pigSignal.title: Verified Swine Data. Actionable Signals.
pigSignal.subtitle_line1: A B2B data API platform — 27 years and 150M+ farm records (~32% of Korea's sow herd), anonymized and aggregated.
pigSignal.subtitle_line2: Assess insurance loss ratios, livestock loan risk, and feed demand shifts faster — with no individual farm exposure.
pigSignal.ntIntegration_line1: N ≥ 10 anonymity · privacy by design · audit-ready lineage.

supplyForecast.title: Supply Forecast API
supplyForecast.desc: 30/60/90-day supply projections with confidence intervals. 90-day horizon, daily refresh.

costIndex.title: Benchmark API
costIndex.desc: Regional distributions for PSY, LSY, farrowing rate, NPD. Weekly refresh, 99.9% SLA.

riskSignal.title: Risk Signals API
riskSignal.desc: Early-warning signals for feed cost, disease, supply concentration. 7–30 day lead, 47 regions.

b2bSaas.title: B2B SaaS Solutions
b2bSaas.sectionDesc: Born from a team of 10 that moves at the speed of 100. B2B productivity tools from real operational experience.

flow9.desc: Flow9 is an enterprise financial management system that automatically allocates revenue, purchases, and labor costs per project, and aggregates cash flow in real time. Move beyond manual Excel work — see your company's P&L and cash flow at a glance.
flow9.f1: Auto monthly proration of revenue/purchases based on project period
flow9.f2: Participation-based labor cost and insurance auto-calculation
flow9.f3: Plan vs. Actual mode switching with monthly comparison
flow9.f4: Transaction entry and bulk Excel upload
flow9.f5: Instant filtering by month, project, and category
flow9.f6: Real-time balance aggregation and income/expense trend dashboard

qbridge.name: QBridge
qbridge.headline: Unify All Customer Consultations in One Place
qbridge.headlineSub: All customer consultations in one place. An integrated CRM for SMEs.
qbridge.desc: QBridge is an integrated CRM that consolidates customer consultations from phone, KakaoTalk, email, and more into one platform. Every interaction is recorded — no customer falls through the cracks.
qbridge.f1: Web-based SaaS accessible from any PC, tablet, or smartphone
qbridge.f2: View customer info and consultation history on a single screen
qbridge.f3: Save frequently used answers as templates and send instantly
qbridge.f4: Search and copy past consultations for consistent response quality
qbridge.f5: Urgent and on-hold cases flagged immediately on login
qbridge.f6: Period reports analyzing consultations by channel, agent, and type
